BiblicalUsage: tsên is the word for a thorn; hence, a cactus-hedge. It appears 2 times in Scripture, including Job 5:5 and Proverbs 22:5.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God gave us tsên because the idea it carries belongs in His Word.
